CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT security.is_active_admin() $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_trainer()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT security.is_active_staff() $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_payment_legacy_bigint(payment_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE payments
  SET deleted_at = NULL
  WHERE id = payment_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL;
  
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.soft_delete_payment_legacy_bigint(payment_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE payments
  SET deleted_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = payment_id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
  
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$
